literal_meaning: আঁতের টান (gut pull or intestines' pull)
figurative_meaning_en: The emotional pull of the heart or deep inner longing, often for home or roots
example_sentences_in_bangla: আঁতের টানে সে প্রতি বছর দেশে ফিরে আসে।
বিদেশে থাকলেও আঁতের টান তাকে শান্তি দিত না।
example_sentences_in_english: The pull of the gut brings him back to the country every year.
Even abroad, the tug of his heart wouldn't let him find peace.
note: This idiom reflects the emotional connection Bengalis feel towards their homeland, especially in diaspora contexts.
